channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK defence exports hit record £20bn in 2025
item.description: Government data indicates British defence exports are on track for their highest annual total since records began in 1983, driven by major naval and aerospace sales. The post UK defence exports hit record £20bn in 2025 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American warship launches missiles at targets in Africa
item.description: A U.S. Navy destroyer has fired Tomahawk missiles into northwest Nigeria following an announcement by President Donald Trump targeting ISIS-linked militants. The post American warship launches missiles at targets in Africa first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: China turns cargo ship into powerful warship
item.description: Recent images from Chinese social media show a standard commercial cargo vessel refitted with sensors, defensive weapons and containerised launchers. The post China turns cargo ship into powerful warship first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Manchester terror plot targeting Jewish community foiled
item.description: Three men have been convicted over a foiled terrorist plot to attack Jewish targets in Greater Manchester, after an undercover operation prevented what police describe as one of the most serious threats seen in the UK in years. The post Manchester terror plot targeting Jewish community foiled first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD outlines RFA pay reform talks
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that discussions are underway to reform pay structures, crewing models and fleet support for the Royal Fleet Auxiliary (RFA), after Gosport MP Caroline Dinenage raised concerns about pay, staffing and readiness. The post MOD outlines RFA pay reform talks first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Birmingham arrest over social media people-smuggling ads
item.description: A man has been arrested in Birmingham on suspicion of advertising people smuggling services online, following a joint operation by the National Crime Agency and West Midlands Police. The post Birmingham arrest over social media people-smuggling ads first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK assesses Russian fleet upgrades and Arctic threat
item.description: Questions from Labour MP Graeme Downie focused on Russia’s Northern Fleet modernisation and Arctic posture. The post UK assesses Russian fleet upgrades and Arctic threat first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Gap year military scheme to launch for under-25s in 2026
item.description: The Ministry of Defence will launch a year-long military experience scheme in 2026, offering paid placements for 18 to 25 year olds across the Army, Royal Navy and Royal Air Force. The post Gap year military scheme to launch for under-25s in 2026 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US Army Secretary briefed on British hybrid navy plans
item.description: The Royal Navy has outlined its plans for a “hybrid navy” and expanded use of uncrewed systems during a visit by United States Secretary of the Army Daniel Driscoll to Portsmouth. The post US Army Secretary briefed on British hybrid navy plans first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain buys new mobile artillery in £52m deal
item.description: The deal with Germany covers one RCH 155 for UK trials, with two more going to Germany for joint testing. The post Britain buys new mobile artillery in £52m deal first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
